tool_schemas.name: get_rss_categories
tool_schemas.description: Lists Cointelegraph RSS feed categories, optionally filtered by status/is_active and sorted, and returns a newline-separated list of category names for the current page; use cursor pagination by passing the returned cursor to fetch the next page, and limit to cap results (1–200). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or sort/order/status values are not allowed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read categories and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request limits are exceeded.

is_active.description: Filter categories by whether they are marked active.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_latest_news
tool_schemas.description:
Fetch the latest news articles from a specified category.

    Parameters:
    - category (str, optional): The category to fetch news from. Must be one of: 
      'all', 'editors_pick', 'latest_news', 'altcoin', 'bitcoin', 'blockchain', 
      'ethereum', 'litecoin', 'monero', 'regulation', 'features', 'analysis', 
      'follow_up', 'in_depth', 'quiz', 'price_analysis', 'market_analysis', 
      'top_10_cryptocurrencies', 'weekly_overview'. Defaults to 'all'.
    - max_results (int, optional): Maximum number of articles to return. If -1, return all articles. Defaults to -1.
    - max_summary_length (int, optional): Maximum length of each article summary in characters. 
      If -1, return full summary. Defaults to 150.
    - ctx (Context, optional): MCP context for logging or additional functionality.

    Returns:
    - str: A formatted list of the latest articles or an error message if none are found.

tool_schemas.name: get_articles
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored articles, optionally filtered by category, status, language, and time window; returns a page of articles with an opaque cursor for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or filter/sort/order values are not allowed.

category_slug.description: Filter to articles associated to this rss_categories.slug; use 'all' to target the designated 'all' category.

published_after.description: Only return articles published at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

published_before.description: Only return articles published at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1–200).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

max_summary_length.description: Presentation-only summary truncation length in characters; does not modify stored articles.

tool_schemas.name: get_article_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single stored article by id. Returns the article record if found; raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not accessible.

max_summary_length.description: Presentation-only summary truncation length in characters; does not modify stored articles.

tool_schemas.name: update_article
tool_schemas.description: Updates writable fields of an existing article, including driving allowed status lifecycle transitions. Returns the updated article. Raises NOT_FOUND if the article does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are invalid or a status transition is not permitted, and CONFLICT if canonical_url uniqueness would be violated.

summary.description: Updated stored summary (full text, not truncated).

status.description: Set article lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active→removed/tombstoned; removed→active/tombstoned; tombstoned has no outgoing transitions.

tool_schemas.name: create_rss_category
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new RSS category configuration. Returns the created rss_categories record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid fields and CONFLICT if slug or rss_url already exists where uniqueness is enforced by the service.

slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier used by get_latest_news.category.

rss_url.description: RSS feed URL for this category.

sort_order.description: Sort position; lower values appear first.

is_active.description: Whether the category is active for listing/selection.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status for the category.

tool_schemas.name: update_rss_category
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing RSS category and/or drives allowed status lifecycle transitions. Returns the updated rss_categories record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the category does not exist and VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are invalid or a status transition is not permitted.

is_active.description: Updated active flag used for filtering/selection.

status.description: Set category lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active→deprecated/disabled; deprecated→active/disabled; disabled→active.

metadata.name: Cointelegraph News
metadata.description: This backend stores Cointelegraph RSS categories, the articles fetched from those feeds, and a request log of tool invocations.
